title: Four-stroke engine
object: 125 cc air-cooled DOHC single in section through the cylinder and valve axes
idea: Turning heat into rotation through a four-phase cycle
summary: An Otto cycle in a finned cylinder. The cams, turning at half crank speed, open each valve by the lift their profile gives; a computed cycle at 6000 rpm (CR 9.2, 58 bar peak) sets the gas, which changes from fresh charge to a flame growing from the plug to burned gas. The P–V diagram traces the loop as the crank turns, with the pumping loop visible on its log scale.
usedFor: Engineering and physics courses: the Otto cycle, valve timing, slider-crank kinematics
Product and service documentation for small engines and motorcycles
A software-concept explainer: a four-stage pipeline (fetch, decode, execute, writeback) with overlapping stages
